Karthus|adc.identity: Area magic damage mage. Lay Waste (Q) creates a delayed explosion, stronger against an isolated enemy. Wall of Pain (W) creates a wall that slows and lowers the magic resist of enemies who cross it. Defile (E) is a damage aura around him that costs a lot of mana (he regains mana when he gets kills). Requiem (R) hits every enemy champion on the map after a 3-second channel. When he dies, Death Defied (passive) gives him a few seconds to keep casting.
Karthus|adc.playstyle: Bot lane mage who farms from range with Q, scales and finishes fights anywhere on the map with Requiem. He has no mobility: he relies on his support and his positioning.
Karthus|adc.early_game: Farm with Lay Waste (Q), which deals more damage to an isolated minion. Hit your opponent when they're alone (no minion next to them in the zone): the damage is stronger. Save Wall of Pain (W) to slow an engage.
Karthus|adc.level_1: Lay Waste (Q) first. Farm and poke with Q.
Karthus|adc.level_2: Defile (E). A damage aura for the wave and close-range fights, but very mana hungry: turn it off as soon as you don't need it.
Karthus|adc.level_3: Wall of Pain (W) (or Q depending on the path). It slows and lowers magic resist: place it between you and a diver, or under your opponent for a kill with your support.
Karthus|adc.level_6: Requiem: damage on every enemy champion on the map. Cast it when an ally is fighting elsewhere or to finish low-health enemies after a fight. Even dead, you can still cast it thanks to your passive.
power_spikes: First completed item: very punishing Q.
Two completed items: a Requiem that kills targets at half health.
Late game: massive area damage in teamfights.
Karthus|adc.lane_plan: Farm safely with Q, poke your isolated opponent and let your support handle engages. Cast Requiem as soon as a fight breaks out elsewhere on the map. The ADC role quest (300 gold, more gold per kill and per minion, then an extra item slot) rewards the steady farming Q allows.
Karthus|adc.trading: Basic trade: Q on your isolated opponent. All-in: W under them, Q, E on. Give up on it against ADCs who chase you down (Zeri): with no mobility, you have to stay behind your support.
threats: Engage supports: you have no dash.
Assassins who kill you before you can cast.
mistakes: Leaving Defile on and draining your mana.
Casting Requiem when no enemy is low or fighting.
Standing in front of your frontline: you have no escape.

matchup_notes.Kai'Sa: Place W between you and her when she dives with her ultimate.
matchup_notes.Jinx: Farm and win teamfights with your area damage.
matchup_notes.Ezreal: He dodges your Qs with his Arcane Shift: aim where he lands.
matchup_notes.Samira: Place W to slow her when she dashes onto you.
matchup_notes.Zeri: She chases you: stay close to your support.

Karthus|adc.mid_game: Join fights and cast Requiem on every skirmish on the map. Farm waves with Q between fights.
Karthus|adc.late_game: Stay behind your frontline, bombard with Q, turn on E if enemies come close. Even if you die, keep casting during your passive.
Karthus|adc.ahead: Cast Requiem on every fight and force objectives.
Karthus|adc.behind: Farm with Q and use Requiem to join kills from afar.
Karthus|adc.win_condition: To win this game, you want to farm, scale and swing every fight on the map with Requiem.
Karthus|adc.final_tip: Watch the whole enemy team's health bars: a well-timed Requiem is worth several kills.
